skills.mode.autoHint: AI decides when to load it from the description
skills.mode.manualHint: Loads only when mentioned with $ in the composer; uses no standing context
skills.warning.shadowed: Conflicts with a higher-priority Skill of the same name and will not take effect
skills.warning.descriptionMissing: Without a description, AI cannot decide when to use it
skills.warning.descriptionLong: The description is long (about {{tokens}} tokens). Move details to the body
skills.introduction: A Skill teaches AI how you want a task done. Automatic mode includes its description and loads the full text when needed. Manual mode loads only when mentioned with $ in the composer.
skills.createHint: Start from a template, draft with AI, or import an existing Skill
skills.builtinHint: Updated with the app; disable or copy it to edit
skills.pluginHint: Follows the plugin’s enabled state; read-only
skills.packageHint: Installed from the plugin center; read-only
skills.linkedHint: Other AI tools’ skills folders · Read-only
skills.remove.title: Delete Skill
skills.remove.description: The entire Skill folder will move to {{trash}}, where you can restore it.
skills.budget.hint: Automatic Skills include their names and descriptions in every conversation’s system prompt
skills.descriptionHint: Description shown to AI · Used to decide when to load
skills.invocationHint: Decide when AI reads this Skill. Preferences stay on this device without changing the original file, including built-in and linked Skills.
skills.manualDeclared: SKILL.md declares disable-model-invocation: true, so manual-only invocation is the default.
skills.editAtSource: From an external folder; edit it in the original tool
skills.exportHint: Package as .zip to import into another tool
skills.removeHint: Move the entire folder to {{trash}}; it can be restored
skills.usage.empty: No conversation has loaded this Skill yet
skills.usage.emptyHint: Loads by AI or mentions with $ will be recorded here
skills.usage.local: Recorded only on this device. Up to 30 recent loads are kept.
skills.copy.doneDisabled: Copied to My Skills; the read-only original is disabled
